Body.Content:
We are announcing the ability to generate a custom grader in Copilot Studio. This feature reached general availability on October 15, 2026.

How does this affect me?
This feature enables you to create a custom grader tailored to a specific agent and evaluation scenario. This makes it easier to expand evaluation coverage across different agents and business scenarios. Generated graders reduce setup effort while still allowing makers to review and adapt the grader before use.

What action do I need to take?
This message is for awareness, and no action is required.
